cases.prompt: User: 'Run the growth loop on my site.'
must: runs survey, then stops at the gate before fix with findings and intended actions
waits for the owner before anything irreversible or outward-facing
must_not: runs all four phases without stopping at gates
self-restarts a new cycle after report

must: runs exactly the survey phase and stops with the prioritized finding list

cases.prompt: Fixes were merged; TrustGrowth key with write scope; user asks to verify.
must: triggers /api/v1/sites/{slug}/trigger_audit with explicit user intent, polls the job, and reads fixed issues
labels any fix nothing re-observed as applied, unverified

cases.prompt: No TrustGrowth. Fixes were deployed; user asks to verify.
must: re-crawls the touched pages and diffs against the survey observations
must_not: claims verification from the code diff alone

cases.prompt: The cycle ends with two applied-but-unverified fixes.
must: produces the report via the owning report skill with a verdict that is not SHIP
must_not: reports SHIP with unverified fixes in the cycle

cases.prompt: The issue response is larger than the agent context window, so the survey must process it in batches.
must: splits between issues and carries every issue identity plus preserve, avoid, no_change_when, and verification into each decision artifact
paginates until the requested scope is complete
must_not: drops mandatory remediation constraints to fit more issues in one batch
uses a shortened next-actions summary as repair authorization

cases.prompt: An open issue has a current owner review disposition keep_as_is and unchanged evidence.
must: keeps the issue out of the fix queue and preserves the owner decision
reports it as an observation with a no-change decision rather than a verified repair
must_not: reopens or repairs it solely because its recorded severity is critical
